schema.content:
Table "Addresses" {
  "address_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "line_1" TEXT
  "line_2" TEXT
  "line_3" TEXT
  "city" TEXT
  "zip_postcode" TEXT
  "state_province_county" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
  "other_address_details" TEXT
}

Table "Assessment_Notes" {
  "notes_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "student_id" INTEGER
  "teacher_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_of_notes" TIMESTAMP
  "text_of_notes" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Behavior_Incident" {
  "incident_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "incident_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "student_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_incident_start" TIMESTAMP
  "date_incident_end" TIMESTAMP
  "incident_summary" TEXT
  "recommendations" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Detention" {
  "detention_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "detention_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "teacher_id" INTEGER
  "datetime_detention_start" TIMESTAMP
  "datetime_detention_end" TIMESTAMP
  "detention_summary" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Ref_Address_Types" {
  "address_type_code" TEXT [pk]
  "address_type_description" TEXT
}

Table "Ref_Detention_Type" {
  "detention_type_code" TEXT [pk]
  "detention_type_description" TEXT
}

Table "Ref_Incident_Type" {
  "incident_type_code" TEXT [pk]
  "incident_type_description" TEXT
}

Table "Student_Addresses" {
  "student_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_address_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "date_address_to" TIMESTAMP
  "monthly_rental" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}

Table "Students" {
  "student_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "middle_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "cell_mobile_number" TEXT
  "email_address" TEXT
  "date_first_rental" TIMESTAMP
  "date_left_university" TIMESTAMP
  "other_student_details" TEXT
}

Table "Students_in_Detention" {
  "student_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "detention_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "incident_id" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Teachers" {
  "teacher_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "address_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "first_name" TEXT
  "middle_name" TEXT
  "last_name" TEXT
  "gender" TEXT
  "cell_mobile_number" TEXT
  "email_address" TEXT
  "other_details" TEXT
}
